_meta.name: Landing in India — arrival-logistics reel bank
_meta.rule: Every claim is sourced (see audit). null/absent = honest scarcity (beat skipped). Single sentences, English, en-IN voice; captions == voice. No fares/numbers unless authoritatively confirmed.
_meta.structure: Each reel = city hook + vibe + visa + transport + signature + 2 rotated national tips + CTA. vibe/transport/signature are CITY-SPECIFIC so reels don't read identically; national tips rotate from the pool so the constant advice varies airport to airport.

national.visa: Most passports need an India e-Visa — sort it online before you fly.

tips.taxi_safe: Take the official prepaid taxi, or an app cab from the marked zone.
tips.scam: If anyone says your hotel is closed, ignore them — it's a classic scam.
tips.sim: Grab a tourist SIM at arrivals — passport, visa, and one photo.
tips.money: Use an ATM in arrivals, not the forex counters, for a better rate.
tips.water: Skip the tap water — stick to sealed bottles your whole trip.
tips.mrp: Check the printed MRP on packs — that's the most you should pay.

airports.vibe: Delhi hits you with its sheer scale and energy.
airports.transport: The Airport metro hits the city in about twenty minutes, for sixty rupees.
airports.signature: Your hotel could be an hour off in traffic, so don't cut timing fine.

airports.vibe: Mumbai is humid, loud, and never sleeps.
airports.transport: The new Aqua Line metro runs underground, right to Terminal Two.
airports.signature: The local trains are the city's lifeline — but brutal at rush hour.

airports.vibe: Step out in Chennai and the heat and humidity hit at once.
airports.transport: The Blue Line metro runs straight from the airport into the city.
airports.signature: Filter coffee here is a ritual — grab one as soon as you can.

airports.vibe: Kolkata runs on old-world charm, chaos, and street food.
airports.transport: The new Yellow Line metro links the airport into the city.
airports.signature: The yellow Ambassador taxis are a city icon, though an app's easier.

airports.vibe: Bengaluru surprises you — cool and green most of the year.
airports.transport: The airport's about forty kilometres out — allow an hour into town.
airports.signature: The traffic is legendary, so pad your transfer time generously.

airports.vibe: Hyderabad blends old nizami charm with a tech-city buzz.
airports.transport: The airport's a fair way out, so plan for a longer ride in.
airports.signature: The biryani here is the real deal — make it your first meal.

airports.vibe: Kochi is green, humid, and laced with backwaters.
airports.transport: The airport's about thirty kilometres north — allow an hour.
airports.signature: Fun fact — it's the world's first fully solar-powered airport.

airports.vibe: Land in Goa and you feel the pace drop at once.
airports.transport: Mopa airport serves North Goa — the top beaches are an hour away.
airports.signature: Goa runs on cash — many beach shacks won't take cards.
airports.ride_note: Ride apps are limited here — use the prepaid taxi or the GoaMiles app.

airports.vibe: Thiruvananthapuram is Kerala at its most laid-back.
airports.transport: The airport's barely five kilometres out — you're in town in minutes.
airports.signature: Kovalam's famous beaches are a short ride down the coast.

airports.vibe: Ahmedabad is dry heat, deep history, and big food.
airports.transport: The airport's about nine kilometres north of the centre.
airports.signature: Gujarat is a dry state — you'll need a tourist permit to drink.

airports.vibe: Jaipur greets you with desert heat and pink-stone forts.
airports.transport: The airport's about fifteen kilometres from the Pink City.
airports.signature: Haggle hard in the bazaars — first prices are aimed at tourists.

airports.airport_name: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International
airports.vibe: Amritsar runs on faith, history, and incredible food.
airports.transport: The airport's a twenty-minute ride from the Golden Temple.
airports.signature: The Golden Temple's free kitchen feeds a hundred thousand a day.
